job: Pick an action or a choice from a short list that belongs to one trigger.
purpose: A floating list of items that opens from a button or a right-click. Items can be actions, checkboxes, radios or sub-menus. Arrow keys move, typing jumps to an item, Escape returns focus to the trigger. Selecting fires a cancelable fd:select; checkbox and radio items fire fd:change. Danger items sit last, below a separator. One menu can serve every row of a table or list: items carry data-fd-when or data-fd-unless and the row carries data-fd-flags, so each row shows only the items that apply.
useWhen: A row or a header has a set of actions behind a "more" button.
Switching team, workspace or environment: use the switcher variant.
Choosing columns or one sort order from a short list.
Rows share one menu but not every action fits every row (Resume only on paused rows).

avoidWhen.when: The content is richer than a list: a summary, a small form, a picker.
A long list with search and counts.
A form field with a value.
A destructive action with no confirmation step.
